name: FastAPI Specialist
notes: Startup errors show in Render logs before app binds to port. Lifespan errors are fatal. Check for SyntaxError in imported modules first.

name: SQLAlchemy Specialist
checks: extend_existing=True on tables that may already exist
notes: New columns require ALTER TABLE or create_all(). The Pawn model needed extend_existing=True. Always close sessions in finally blocks.

name: Security Specialist
checks: no secrets in git (check seed scripts)
API keys only in Render env vars
notes: DB URL is hardcoded in seed scripts — acceptable since seeds run locally not on server. All server secrets in Render env vars only. Never log tokens or keys.

name: Commons-Gleaning Merger Specialist
failure_modes: schema conflicts between Commons and Gleaning DB
checks: SECRET_KEY identical on both Render services
no table name conflicts between Commons and Gleaning models
/gleaning redirect added to The Commons main.py
barter auth works with Commons JWT
notes: The /gleaning redirect in The Commons is still missing. SECRET_KEY must match. Barter verify_commons_token() already built and ready. Merger needs shared DB or cross-service API.

name: Performance Specialist
failure_modes: resource API slow on large result sets
map rendering slow with many markers
checks: Leaflet uses circle markers not full markers
notes: Scanner is daemon thread — won't block app. Resource API limited to 500. Pawns loads all records — may need pagination when list grows beyond 1000.

name: Monitoring Specialist
notes: Check Render logs after deploy. All four systems should show startup messages. If any missing check for import errors in gleaning_circle.py and related files.

name: HRSA All-States Coverage Specialist
notes: HRSA should return results for most states. States with 0 results: check if state code is valid, check if API endpoint changed.

name: Vote Tracker Specialist
failure_modes: vote detail endpoint different from search
checks: name matching uses ILIKE not exact match
notes: Vote tracking currently limited without ProPublica key. Free key at propublica.org/datastore/api. Keyword list in resource_scanner.py PEOPLE_WANT variable.

name: Popup Events Specialist
failure_modes: is_popup=True not set on scanner results
checks: ?popup=1 query param filters correctly in API
notes: 26 manually seeded popup events. Scanner adds more. Get free Eventbrite token at eventbrite.com/platform to increase results.

name: Resource Expansion Specialist
notes: Valid categories: food health housing legal lgbtq unhoused education safety community parking greenbook. Check for duplicates before large seed batches.

key votes empty for scanner-added members

ProPublica key needed for vote data
